position: VedaPath can be shown privately as a source-first prototype, not as a public AI product or spiritual authority.
headline: The private demo should feel calm, honest, and bounded.
copy: Walk through one question, one source packet, one answer boundary, and one reviewer receipt. Then stop and collect feedback.

postures.title: Say
postures.copy: This is a prototype of a source-first learning companion.

postures.title: Say
postures.copy: Public launch waits for rights, reviewer operations, privacy, and live retrieval tests.

postures.title: Do not say
postures.copy: Do not claim live AI, final scholarship, spiritual authority, therapy, or public launch readiness.

postures.title: Do not collect
postures.copy: Do not collect sensitive personal reflections outside the local prototype boundary.

flow.title: Open simply
flow.copy: State the prototype boundary in one sentence.

flow.title: Ask
flow.copy: Use the Oppenheimer question or steady-action question.

flow.title: Show source
flow.copy: Point to citation, source family, confidence, and boundary.

flow.title: Show review
flow.copy: Explain reviewer receipts and blocked fields.

flow.title: Close
flow.copy: Ask what felt trustworthy, confusing, or too much.

decisions.label: Private founder demo
decisions.reason: Script keeps source-first posture and launch locks visible.

decisions.label: Public claims
decisions.reason: Real API, rights, privacy, and reviewer ops are not complete.

decisions.label: Sensitive intake
decisions.reason: No production consent, export, delete, or support flow exists.

decisions.label: Live model
decisions.reason: Adapter and no-source tests must pass in real service first.

locks.title: Prototype lock
locks.copy: Every demo begins by saying this is not a launched product.

locks.title: Rights lock
locks.copy: Do not display unapproved translations as public product content.

locks.title: Privacy lock
locks.copy: Do not collect sensitive user stories or promise account memory.

locks.title: Authority lock
locks.copy: Do not position VedaPath as guru, therapist, ritual authority, or final scholar.

packet:
VedaPath Private Demo Script v4.6.5
Opening: This is a source-first learning prototype, not a launched AI authority.
Demo path: Ask > Source packet > Bounded answer > Reviewer receipt > Feedback.
Allowed: private founder-led walkthrough with static data.
Blocked: public launch, live AI claims, payments, production storage, sensitive intake.
Close: What felt trustworthy? What felt confusing? What should become simpler?
